text: dsh-playwright 是 DSH 的 Playwright 浏览器自动化集成插件，通过 profile bundle 注册一个 MCP 客户端并以 stdio 启动 Playwright MCP。它让 DSH agent 能调用浏览器工具执行网页导航、查看页面快照、点击和输入等操作，适合需要让 agent 操作真实浏览器的工作流。启动时使用 npx 获取并运行 @playwright/mcp；本机需有 Node.js 与 npx，并可使用 Chrome 或 Chromium。

dsh-playwright adds Playwright browser automation to DSH by registering an MCP client in the profile bundle and launching the server over stdio. Agents can navigate pages, inspect snapshots, click, and type. Startup uses npx to fetch @playwright/mcp; Node.js, npx, and Chrome or Chromium are needed.
让 DSH agent 能打开网页并操作浏览器。
I want my DSH agent to navigate and interact with websites in a browser.
想让 agent 查看网页结构后再点击和输入内容。
dsh-playwright 功能「Playwright 浏览器控制」：profile 中的 MCP 客户端启动 Playwright MCP，向 DSH 暴露浏览器工具，供 agent 导航、查看快照、点击和输入。
dsh-playwright 通过 npx 启动 @playwright/mcp@latest，首次运行需从 npm 获取该包；需安装 Node.js 与 npx。（见 cordis.patch.yml:4-6,20-24）

dsh-playwright README · dsh-playwright：[](https://dsh-plugin.org/plugins/akash-digitavision/dsh-playwright)

**One-line value:** install this and every DeepSeek Harness agent can drive a real browser — navigation, clicking, typing, snapshots, screenshots — using the official Microsoft Playwright MCP.

dsh-playwright README · dsh-playwright：DeepSeek Harness profile bundle installing the **official Microsoft Playwright MCP** (`@playwright/mcp`) — browser automation through structured **accessibility snapshots** (no vision model needed), from [github.com/microsoft/playwright-mcp](https://github.com/microsoft/playwright-mcp). Same bundle pattern as `dsh-chrome-devtools`.

dsh-playwright README · dsh-playwright：**Capability category:** 工具与能力 (Tools & Capabilities)
**License:** MIT · **Compatibility:** DSH ≥ 0.2.0-rc.2 (bundles API), Windows/macOS/Linux (Node.js + npx + Chrome/Chromium required)

Configuration source: verified via Context7 against the project's own README — the standard client config is exactly:

```json
{ "mcpServers": { "playwright": { "command": "npx", "args": ["@playwright/mcp@latest"] } } }
```

dsh-playwright README · What it adds to every agent on the profile：| Row | Module | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `mcp-playwright` | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` | Spawns `npx @playwright/mcp@latest` (stdio) → tools namespaced `mcp__playwright__*`: `browser_navigate`, `browser_snapshot`, `browser_click`, `browser_type`, `browser_take_screenshot`, tabs, requests, and more |

dsh-playwright README · What it adds to every agent on the profile：- Uses your **installed Google Chrome** by default (headed, persistent profile)
- First start downloads the package via npx (30–60s); afterwards it starts in ~1s
- Coexists with `dsh-chrome-devtools` — separate tool namespace and browser instance

text:
dsh-playwright README · Install：**One command (recommended):**

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:akash-digitavision/dsh-playwright
```

or in **Settings → Plugin Market** (DSH Plugin Hub), search for `dsh-playwright`.

**Manual alternative** — add `dsh-playwright` to the profile `package.json` `dependencies` + `dsh.profile.bundles`, run `pnpm install` in the profile, restart or re-apply.

**Requirements:** Node.js ≥ 18 with npx (the MCP server downloads on first use), and an installed Chrome or Chromium.

dsh-playwright README · Install：> Note: `file:` dependencies are **copied** into the profile by pnpm — after editing this bundle's `cordis.patch.yml`, run `pnpm install` again (or edit the installed copy under `node_modules\dsh-playwright`) before re-applying.

dsh-playwright README · Permissions & external services：- Spawns a local `npx @playwright/mcp` process that launches a real browser on your machine
- No accounts, no API keys, no telemetry; network access is whatever pages you browse
- Edits/automation run with your user privileges — review prompts before approving destructive actions

dsh-playwright README · Optional launch flags：Append to `args` in `cordis.patch.yml`:

| Flag | Effect |
|---|---|
| `--isolated` | In-memory profile; no persisted cookies/storage |
| `--headless` | No visible browser window |
| `--browser chromium` | Playwright's bundled Chromium instead of system Chrome |
| `--caps=vision,pdf` | Extra capability tools |
| `--config <file.json>` | Full JSON configuration (browser, timeouts, network rules, secrets — see project docs) |
dsh-playwright README · Verify：Ask the agent to `browser_navigate` to any page and `browser_snapshot` it — or check the plugin list for the live `include:mcp-playwright` entry.

dsh-playwright README · Publish / uninstall：Push this folder to GitHub and install `"dsh-playwright": "github:<you>/dsh-playwright"`. Remove from `bundles` + `dependencies` to uninstall; the npx cache can be kept or cleared separately.
